title: Cargo Door Latch Shaft Assembly — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of one cargo door latch shaft assembly with new bearing bushes, including the end float check and the shimming of the door warning sensor target that follows it.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one latch shaft assembly with its bearing bushes, the end float check and the shimming of the door warning sensor target plate.
sections.job_setup_note: The latch stiffener bore must have been measured and accepted by the removal task. Self-lubricating bushes must be installed dry: no grease of any kind is permitted in the bore or on the shaft journal. The door must stay on the support strut until the operational test, and the door warning system must be available for the target shimming step.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: KEEP THE DOOR SUPPORT STRUT FITTED UNTIL THE OPERATIONAL TEST IS COMPLETE. 2. Clean the bore of the latch stiffener D5230135108629 and make sure that it is dry. 3. CAUTION: DO NOT APPLY GREASE TO A SELF-LUBRICATING BUSH OR TO ITS BORE. GREASE MAKES THE LINER FAIL EARLY. 4. Press the four bushes into the bore with the insertion adapter, square to the face. 5. Install the retaining angle D5230139019163 with blind rivets EN989730K5 and swaged collars LN181939-7B. 6. Install the shaft from the outboard end, supported at both ends. 7. Connect the latch actuator link at the shaft crank and lockwire the connection. 8. Measure the shaft end float and confirm that it is inside the limit given in the task. 9. Shim the target plate of the door warning sensor 8511WT to the measured end float. 10. Do the latch rigging check and confirm that the latch actuator 331WT4 reaches both end positions. 11. Install the latch access panels. 12. Do the cargo door operational test and the door warning system test.
sections.close_out: Remove the door support strut only after the operational test has passed. Make sure that the compartment is clear of tools. Record the installed bush standard, the end float and the shim thickness in the aircraft technical record, and delete the latch shaft lubrication task from the maintenance schedule if the self-lubricating bushes have been fitted.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Bushes must be replaced as a matched set of four; a single-bush replacement is not permitted.

safety_precautions: Keep the door support strut fitted until the operational test is complete.
Isolate the cargo door control system until the rigging check.
Do not stand below the door while the shaft is installed.
